item.title: Portland upholds land use violation against ICE facility
item.description: The City of Portland announced Friday it is upholding its land use violation notice against the South Portland U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement facility.

item.title: MultCo Animal Services pauses dog intakes, adoptions after 2 deaths amid outbreak
item.description: Two dogs have died amid a respiratory illness outbreak at Multnomah County Animal Services, leading the shelter to pause all dog intakes and adoptions, the county announced Friday.
